passage: For more than a decade, a biologist tracked the routes of shorebirds that fly between the Arctic and South America. Having studied the migration data for years, ______
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: the biologist identified a previously unknown stopover site.
a previously unknown stopover site was identified by the biologist.
the data revealed a previously unknown stopover site.
a previously unknown stopover site became clear to the biologist.
explanation: The opening phrase "Having studied the migration data for years" must describe the noun right after the comma. Only the biologist studied the data, so the sentence must continue with "the biologist".
source: Emir original item, written to the College Board Digital SAT content specifications
steps: Ask who did the action in "Having studied the migration data for years."
Only a person can study data, so here it is the biologist.
The noun right after the comma must be "the biologist."
The other choices put "a stopover site" or "the data" right after the comma, and neither can study anything.
key: Dangling modifiers: an introductory phrase describes the noun right after the comma.
